Six objectives, with the distinctions that actually cost money:
read     answer from evidence already held        must reach no provider
research fresh check of a KNOWN/NAMED entity      one scoped paid call
source   discovery of entities we do not know     full discovery spend
converse opinion, judgement, discussion           no work product
Near-miss pairs are deliberate. Cases that differ by one word and route
differently are what separate understanding from keyword matching.
